name: Murasaki Sumire
source:
"Hugs, hugs, hugs! HUGS FOR EVERYONE!!!"

Sumire is Komachi's bubbly self-proclaimed journalist extraordinaire. A huge fan of the supernaturals, she has been disappointed to hear Komachi High's very own Occult Club only accepts senior students! But it's alright, that doesn't mean Sumire can't conduct her own independent investigation.

Despite her mind~over~matter personality, Sumire is sharp-minded and quite witty for her age. Watch out mysteries! Sumire is coming for you!

[From [url=https://flutteringabyss.itch.io/missingtime]Itch.io[/url]]
